about_html: I'm an Associate Professor of Accounting at Yale School of Management. Prior to joining Yale, I spent seven years on the faculty at the London School of Economics. I received a PhD in Accounting from Stanford University in 2017 and my undergraduate degrees from Yale in 2011.
My research interests span non-financial misconduct, ESG issues, and political connections (especially subsidies)
You can find my official Yale webpage here.
interests: My research interests span non-financial misconduct, ESG issues, and corporate subsidies. If there is no link to a paper below, please contact me directly if you would like a copy.
